parole.significato: Cariban, belonging to one of the Carib peoples or relating to their cultures and languages
parole.testo: From a Taíno or Kalinago term corresponding to karifuna (“Kalinago person”) in modern Kalinago, a borrowing from a Cariban language, ultimately from Proto-Cariban *karipona (“person”). Compare Kari'na karìna (“Carib person”).
